tasks.message: Entity selection doesn't populate campaign_id on selected entities when the run is started by campaign. Fix it and add a test. Work in Spring-Oaks-Capital-LLC/filter. If the default branch already does this, open no PR: say where it is implemented and which test covers it. Otherwise open a draft pull request against its default branch titled "[enact-golden] <short summary>", wait for the repository's own CI and report the PR URL and the check results. Do not merge.

must_include: the repository's own CI checks passing on the PR head
a test asserting campaign_id on selected entities
must_not: disables, skips or deletes existing tests to make CI pass
prints a secret, API key or token value
